prompt:
Create a high-fidelity UI design comparison for OmniGear, the mouse/keyboard configurator. Use the supplied approved HOME image ONLY as the visual identity reference: same OmniGear wordmark, neutral black/white palette, clean sans typography, thin borders, restrained corners, spacing and realistic matte black mouse. Replace home content with the Mouse / Botões configuration workspace.
Output one square board containing TWO equal full desktop landscape viewports stacked vertically: dark above, light below, each approximately 2:1 aspect ratio. Identical layout and content across themes. Crisp readable Brazilian Portuguese text. No external board title, browser frame or perspective mockup.
Both viewports: top header OmniGear with small 'Demonstração' badge left, one single sun-switch-moon theme toggle right (dark thumb right; light thumb left). No Claro/Escuro buttons. Beneath header, fixed left sidebar about 18% width: '← Dispositivos', device title 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown, divider, nav items 'Botões' selected, 'DPI', 'Desempenho', 'Parâmetros', 'Perfis', 'Dispositivo'. Main heading 'Botões', subtitle 'Escolha um botão e defina sua ação.' Main content uses realistic top view matte black ergonomic mouse, with left/right buttons, wheel, and two thumb buttons physically on LEFT side. Five small numbered hotspots 1 left, 2 right, 3 wheel, 4 upper side, 5 lower side. Fifth button selected. Do not duplicate numbers or place side button hotspot on palm. Action selected is 'Voltar'. No RGB, invented battery values, brand claims or extra features.
Bottom action bar within main content: left '1 alteração não salva' with neutral small dot, right subtle 'Descartar' then primary 'Salvar no perfil'. In dark primary button white with black text; in light black with white text. This is clearly a working settings screen, not a marketing poster. Match reference material and contrast.

STRUCTURE OPTION 3: Below heading one broad open canvas, mouse vertically centered as dominant focal object. Five concise labels connected to matching mouse hotspots by thin elbow leader lines: '1  Clique esquerdo' above-left, '2  Clique direito' above-right, '3  Clique central' middle-right, '4  Avançar' middle-left, and '5  Voltar' lower-left connected accurately to LOWER LEFT side thumb button. Selected hotspot5 opens a small context popover immediately to its left, replacing its plain label. Popover: '5  Lateral traseiro', label 'Ação atribuída', dropdown 'Voltar' with chevron, quiet action 'Restaurar botão'. No inspector sidebar, no assignment table. Keep labels airy around mouse, avoid lines crossing or overlaps. Mouse only tall enough to leave space for heading and footer. Bottom quiet hint 'Selecione um botão no mouse.' and standard bottom action bar. All five assignments remain discoverable around the device.
title: Edição sobre o mouse
description: Mouse centralizado, com atribuições ao redor e editor junto ao botão selecionado.
approvalSource: User: vamos de 3. Later requested Geral label and single sun/moon theme icon; revised artifact supersedes these details.
